ayahs.1: Padh apne Rabb ke naam se jis ne paida kiya.
ayahs.2: Jis ne insaan ko khoon ke lothde se paida kiya.
ayahs.3: Tu padhta reh, tera Rabb bade karam wala hai.
ayahs.4: Jis ne qalam ke zariye (ilm) sikhaya.
ayahs.5: Jis ne insaan ko woh sikhaya jise woh nahin jaanta tha.
ayahs.6: Sach much insaan to aape se baahar ho jaata hai.
ayahs.7: Is liye ke woh apne aap ko be-parwa (ya tawangar) samajhta hai.
ayahs.8: Yaqeenan lautna tere Rabb ki taraf hai.
ayahs.9: (Bhala) use bhi tu ne dekha jo bande ko rokta hai.
ayahs.10: Jabke woh banda namaz ada karta hai.
ayahs.11: Bhala batla to agar woh hidayat par ho.
ayahs.12: Ya parhezgaari ka hukm deta ho.
ayahs.13: Bhala dekho to agar yeh jhutlaata ho aur munh phirta ho to.
ayahs.14: Kya us ne nahin jaana ke Allah Taala use khoob dekh raha hai.
ayahs.15: Yaqeenan agar yeh baaz na raha to hum us ki peshaani ke baal pakad kar ghaseetenge.
ayahs.16: Aisi peshaani jo jhoothi khataa-kaar hai.
ayahs.17: Yeh apni majlis walon ko bula le.
ayahs.18: Hum bhi (dozakh ke) piyaadon ko bula lenge.
ayahs.19: Khabardaar! Is ka kehna hargiz na maanna aur sajda kar aur qareeb ho ja.
